body.objective: Land the smallest missing validated-ODE primitive needed by the Phase-3 Schwarzschild axial pilot: a rigorous real coupled linear IVP and fundamental-matrix enclosure on a finite nonsingular radial interval. This is the first executable child of the accepted broad M25 vector-BVP request, not a request for the full singular-endpoint or boundary-value stack.
body.stop_condition: Add a generic lib/math validated real vector-linear-IVP API for y'=A(t)y on a finite nonsingular interval, accepting a caller-supplied outward-rounded interval extension of A and returning a box enclosure for y together with existence/uniqueness receipts. Add a fundamental-matrix mode that encloses every entry, uses explicit wrapping control (Lohner/QR or an equivalently proved method), retains per-step a-priori boxes and refusal reasons, and composes with math/ivmat for endpoint-basis solves. Pass an exactly solvable coupled Hamiltonian control with constant symplectic current and the physics consumer black_hole_programme/phase3/validated_connection_preflight: realify the declared 2x2 complex axial master system to 4x4 at ell=2, M=1, hat_omega=3/5 on r in [3,4], enclose its 4x4 fundamental matrix, and rigorously enclose the matrix current-conservation defect. The enclosure must exclude a declared nonzero mutation of one coefficient and must remain valid under a stricter independent subdivision. The API must be sufficient to cover each rational frequency subbox in the frozen pilot interval hat_omega in [1/2,3/4], though uniform parameter continuation and singular endpoint initialization remain later M25 clauses.
body.current_gate: validated coupled fundamental flow before any horizon-to-infinity shooting result can be called a connection theorem
body.forbid: no componentwise scalar-IVP calls that discard correlations; no floating trajectory or convergence table called an enclosure; no interval extension whose validity is merely assumed without an explicit caller obligation and negative control; no uncontrolled matrix inverse; no black-hole-specific equation embedded in lib/math; no BVP, singular-endpoint, global scattering or stability promotion from this finite-interval primitive; no interval overlap read as exact equality
activates: validated finite-interval transfer and flux-conservation enclosures
body.resource_hint: NARROW HIGH-PRIORITY M25 CHILD. The existing math/ivode state is one real Iv and cannot express a coupled 4-real-dimensional flow or the correlations among 16 fundamental-matrix entries. math/ivmat already supplies interval matrix products and certified rational-center solves. Reuse it rather than implementing BVP or endpoint-series machinery in this item. The physics preflight certificate includes an independent DOP853/RK4 observation and a rounded-output mutation showing why small residuals are not proofs.
notes: The accepted request sf:forge-request/validated-vector-bvp-connection-flux remains the broad parent. This request deliberately splits only its first finite-interval fundamental-flow clause so the Phase-3 pilot need not wait for singular endpoints, BVP Newton, complex parameter continuation or certified Frobenius tails.
Complex coefficients may be represented by exact real 2x2 blocks; a separate complex-interval scalar type is not required for this first pass.
Endpoint basis-conditioning can use math/ivmat after the flow is enclosed. Certified horizon/infinity series remainders are a separate endpoint-basis work item and are not silently included here.

Frozen downstream domain: axial ell=2, M=1, hat_omega in [1/2,3/4]. The first substrate fixture is the center hat_omega=3/5 on r in [3,4]; this does not itself establish an open-frequency connection theorem.

LANDED 2026-07-22 in Forge commit 5de8107da: math/ivlinode supplies rigorous coupled real linear-IVP and fundamental-matrix enclosures using interval Peano-Baker factors with a proved geometric tail, retained ordered local factors, per-step all-times boxes, typed refusal data, vector application and Phi^T J1 Phi-J0 enclosure. The exact Hamiltonian and realified axial ell=2, hat_omega=3/5 fixtures pass native/C parity and ASan, including full [1/2,3/4] frequency-box acceptance and coefficient-mutation rejection. Honest remaining boundary: long ill-conditioned transfer still needs QR/Lohner-style wrapping or certified subdivision discipline; singular endpoint tails, BVP matching and scattering are not supplied by this primitive.
